One coherent system

The square frame is a place; the continuous stroke is a mark. Keep one symbol-width of clear space around the lockup. Minimum symbol 24px; favicon 16px is a dedicated exception. Never stretch, rotate or recolor the mark with creator colors.

History has a place.

Georgia for editorial headings; system UI for controls and reading; tabular numerals for server prices and timers. 4px spacing base; 8px controls, 16px cards, pill status labels. Flat by default, optional small overlay shadow. No gradients or decorative animation.

Same signature, every format

Only public, approved derivatives belong in production share cards. These static templates contain no user IDs, originals, prices, proof of payment or fabricated live ownership. Creator identity lives in the central panel; the platform mark remains in the header.

Export-ready essentials

Accessibility and handoff

Approved text pairs pass 4.5:1; meaningful control boundaries and focus pass 3:1. Never communicate status by color alone. Controls have 44px targets. Verify keyboard focus, 200% zoom, long names and creator artwork contrast on every integrated screen. Generated contrast data lives in contrast.json; usage and limits in README.md.

Brand Kit v1 preview · Native vectors, no external fonts or requests. Open README.md for decisions, token mapping and remaining acceptance gates.
